sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER PARTS OF CNTRL FL
sections.text: ...SYNOPSIS... WITH THE MAIN BELT OF THE WLYS REMAINING WELL TO THE NORTH ACROSS CANADA...AND A BROAD RIDGE BUILDING EWD FROM THE RCKYS/PLNS...THE UPR LOW ASSOCIATED WITH WHAT WAS HYBRID T.D. LEE LIKELY WILL DRIFT/REDEVELOP SLOWLY N THIS PERIOD...REACHING ERN KY BY 12Z WED. AT LWR LVLS...REMNANT SFC LOW WITH LEE...NOW OVER NRN GA...SHOULD FURTHER WEAKEN AS IT TOO CONTINUES SLOWLY NWD. TRAILING WIND SHIFT/COLD FRONT EXTENDING S FROM THE LOW WILL PROGRESS E/SE ACROSS SC...ERN GA...AND N FL LATER TODAY...WHILE SHALLOW FRONT EXTENDING ENE FROM THE LOW BECOMES STNRY OVER NW NC. THE ERN PART OF THIS BOUNDARY MAY RETURN NWD ACROSS SE VA AND THE LWR ERN SHORE OF MD LATER TODAY/TNGT.

sections.title: CAROLINAS/SRN VA TODAY/TNGT
sections.text: VERY MOIST AIR WILL PERSIST IN SLY LOW LVL FLOW AHEAD OF WIND SHIFT/COLD FRONT OVER THE CAROLINAS TODAY...S OF STALLING FRONT NEAR THE NC/VA BORDER. WHILE THE WIND FIELD OVER THE REGION WILL GRADUALLY DIMINISH AS LEE FURTHER WEAKENS...AMPLE LOW TO MID LVL SHEAR WILL REMAIN FOR SUSTAINED STORMS AND EVEN SUPERCELLS IN WARM SECTOR...WHERE CONFLUENT 30-35 KT SSELY LOW LVL WINDS WILL LINGER BENEATH 40-50 KT SLY FLOW IN THE 700-500 MB LAYER. MID LVL LAPSE RATES WILL REMAIN WEAK. BUT COMBINATION OF MODERATE TO LOCALLY STRONG SFC HEATING OF VERY MOIST...CONFLUENT BOUNDARY LAYER SHOULD SUPPORT DEVELOPMENT/INTENSIFICATION OF SCTD TO BROKEN BANDS OF STORMS ALONG AND AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT. A FEW TORNADOES MAY OCCUR...MAINLY OVER PIEDMONT NC AND INTO SE VA NEAR STALLING FRONT. BUT THE GREATEST RISK MAY BE FOR LOCALLY DMGG WIND FROM SMALL BOWS. THE SVR THREAT SHOULD DIMINISH WITH SUNSET. HOWEVER...SPORADIC INSTANCES OF SVR...INCLUDING BOTH DMGG GUSTS AND POSSIBLY A TORNADO...MAY OCCUR THROUGH EARLY WED OVER ERN NC AND SE VA.

sections.title: FL TODAY
sections.text: BAND OF PRE-FRONTAL TSTMS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE E/SE ACROSS THE FL PENINSULA...WITH SOME STRENGTHENING/ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT LIKELY DUE TO STRONG SFC HEATING. RELATIVELY WEAK MID LVL LAPSE RATES SHOULD MINIMIZE OVERALL SVR THREAT. HOWEVER...A FEW SUSTAINED STORMS/MULTICELL CLUSTERS WITH SMALL BOWS/LOCALLY DMGG WIND MAY OCCUR GIVEN SEASONABLY STRONG /25-30 KT/ WSWLY 700 MB FLOW AND STEEPENING LOW LVL LAPSE RATES.

sections.title: SW CONUS/FOUR CORNERS AREA THIS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: A JET STREAK EXTENDING FROM THE LWR CO VLY TO THE CNTRL RCKYS WILL BISECT THE WRN U.S. UPR RIDGE THIS PERIOD. RELATIVELY STRONG HIGH LVL FLOW AND STEEP LOW TO MID LVL LAPSE RATES COULD YIELD A FEW STORMS CAPABLE OF GUSTY WINDS/SMALL HAIL. HOWEVER...WITH THE LWR TROPOSPHERIC FLOW REMAINING FAIRLY WEAK AND WITH PW LIMITED...THE THREAT FOR APPRECIABLE SVR WEATHER APPEARS LOW. ..CORFIDI/GARNER.. 09/06/2011

sections.title: DELMARVA TO CAROLINAS
sections.text: MID-MORNING MESOANALYSIS SHOWED PRIMARY SURFACE LOW OVER NWRN GA WITH AN ASSOCIATED BAROCLINIC ZONE EXTENDING NEWD ALONG THE TN-NC BORDER...CURVING EWD ACROSS NRN NC...AND THEN NEWD THROUGH SERN VA. LATEST MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGESTS THAT THE SURFACE LOW WILL DEVELOP NWD INTO ERN KY BY 07/12Z WHILE TRAILING COLD FRONT ADVANCES EWD THROUGH THE SAVANNAH RIVER VALLEY AND CAROLINA PIEDMONT BY THE END OF THE D1 PERIOD. MEANWHILE...REGENERATIVE STORM DEVELOPMENT TO THE N OF QUASI-STATIONARY BOUNDARY ACROSS NRN NC/SERN VA WILL SERVE TO ENHANCE BAROCLINITY...AND PERHAPS ALLOW FOR A SLIGHT SWD DRIFT TODAY. THIS FRONT IS FORECAST TO PIVOT NWWD THROUGH ERN VA OVERNIGHT IN RESPONSE TO SURFACE LOW DEVELOPING NWD INTO THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS. 12Z REGIONAL SOUNDINGS ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR INDICATE LITTLE OR NO CAPPING...AND BREAKS IN THE CLOUDS HAVE ALLOWED TEMPERATURES TO WARM INTO THE 80S...CONTRIBUTING TO MLCAPE OF 1000-2000 J/KG. THIS INSTABILITY COINCIDES WITH A CORRIDOR OF ENHANCED MERIDIONAL FLOW ALONG ERN PERIPHERY OF DEEP-LAYER CYCLONE...RESULTING IN SUFFICIENT VERTICAL SHEAR FOR SUPERCELLS AND BOWING STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND TORNADOES. AN ISOLATED WIND/TORNADO THREAT MAY PERS

sections.title: FL
sections.text: CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ASSOCIATED WITH ONGOING TSTMS IS RAPIDLY PROGRESSING SEWD THROUGH THE CNTRL PENINSULA AS OF LATE MORNING...AND AWAY FROM STRONGER MID-TROPOSPHERIC FLOW PRESENT ACROSS NRN PART OF THE STATE. STEEPENING LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND MLCAPE VALUES OF 1500-3000 J/KG ACROSS WARM SECTOR WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT VIGOROUS UPDRAFTS ALONG AND AHEAD OF OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. AND WHILE...LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE...THE SWD DISPLACEMENT OF THE INSTABILITY AXIS FROM THE HIGHER MOMENTUM FLOW IS EXPECTED TO LIMIT THE POTENTIAL FOR A MORE ROBUST WIND THREAT. THEREFORE...CATEGORICAL SLIGHT RISK HAS BEEN REMOVED FROM AREA. ..MEAD/LEITMAN.. 09/06/2011
